If you're not intending on providing services, simply don't charge the patient for them...

Thank you.

The hospital is not one of the shiny new ones with a Starbucks etc but I want to praise the nurse/assistant Pang. She speaks English well and is very sweet and works extremely hard to make people feel ok and she’s very competent and professional.
Staff are welcomed. The doc nahhhh the doc a bad doc. Not even touched 😆😆😆 …

My friend had strong diarrhea / gastroenteritis  and 39° fever because of unknown reason. At checkin at 8pm we could show an AXA Thai sawadee travel health insurance policy. Because the health issue was not simple we stay there for 2 nights. The doctor and the staff (nurse and helper) cared very much. Most of staff speaks English well, especially the doctors, emergency staff and nurses. Everything was fine. The food was served and taste good. My friend was not over medicated as I experienced in other hospital. I also could stay in the room with own bed, VIP-room, take care if your insurance covers more than standard romm, otherwise you pay 1000 thb for your VIP room extra. AXA standard plan does not cover VIP room. Special thank to Dr. Med CHAINARIN.  Khap khun krap mak mak. Sawadee khrap 🙏

Came to hospital on Sunday, Dr Chainarin and his team were excellent. Prompt service, answered all questions, got me feeling better asap. Room was clean, everything was great. Couldn't have asked for a better hospital service 👍👍 …

I came to Chiang Mai memorial hospital on a Sunday after having had a red body rash, all over and feeling so very sick for 4 days.  I   was treated excellently from start to finish by all hospital personal, but especially by Dr Chainarin.

He gave lots of test, importantly, an early blood test to confirm I had contacted Dengue Fever!( I had previously seen a doctor at another hospital who said it was an allergic reaction and gave me antihistamines and cream, which did not help!)

After the dengue  diagnosis which included a chest X-ray, it was suggested that I could stay overnight if that was helpful. I was very dehydrated and potassium deficient as well as super teary.
I was processed quickly and given an intravenous drip full of redyradtion medicine and given a number of options to ease my extremely itchy skin.
This morning, I feel almost normal after feeling dreadful for a few days.

Dr chainarin was also kind and warm- his English is good and when we were at a word impasse. Google translate was perfect.

I highly recommend Chiang Mai memorial hospital and particularly Dr Chianarin.

They were also transparent with all the fees each time a new procedure was initiated.
Thankyou for my health back- it means soooo much!
